name: Supercharger with bonnet scoop (Brute 500)
_note: A big twin-screw supercharger on the V8, poking up through a scoop bonnet: an absurd amount of torque everywhere.

sound._note: Its sound (garage/carSound.js, audio/dsp.js): supercharger — its rotors' whine, at the engine's revs per second × ratio (× lobes for a twin-screw or roots), as loud as gain at the redline (a twin-screw at any throttle, a centrifugal mostly flat out); exhaust.level / tone as it changes the engine's.

madeBy.design: twin-screw blower with a forward throttle body
